name: Question 8
problem:
$x$ is negative **or** rational, **and** $x$ is positive **or** an  integer.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

- $N(x):$ $x$ is negative

- $R(x):$ $x$ is rational

- $P(x):$ $x$ is positive

- $I(x):$ $x$ is an integer
worked_solution:
The word "and" is represented by the symbol "$∧$," while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "$∨.$"

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

- **Part 1:** $x$ is negative **or** rational. This corresponds to

$$
{{x\text{ is negative }}_{⏟}}_{N}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{x\text{ is rational }}_{⏟}}_{R},
$$

that is, $N∨R.$

- **Part 2:** $x$ is positive **or** an integer. This corresponds to

$$
{{x\text{ is positive }}_{⏟}}_{P}\,{{\text{or}}_{⏟}}_{∨}\,{{x\text{ is an integer }}_{⏟}}_{I},
$$

that is, $P∨I.$

So, we can express the sentence as

$$
{{x\text{ is negative or rational}}_{⏟}}_{N\,∨\,R}\,{{\text{and}}_{⏟}}_{∧}\,{{x\text{ is positive or an integer }}_{⏟}}_{P\,∨\,I},
$$

that is, $(N∨R)∧(P∨I).$

html:
Question 8
?

x is negative or rational, and x is positive or an integer.

Express the compound predicate above in symbolic form given the following notations:

  • N(x): x is negative

  • R(x): x is rational

  • P(x): x is positive

  • I(x): x is an integer

a
(N∧R)∧(P∧I)
b
(N∨R)∨(P∨I)
c
((N∨R)∧P)∨I
d
(N∨R)∧(P∨I)
e
(N∧R)∨(P∧I)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The word "and" is represented by the symbol "∧," while the word "or" is represented by the symbol "∨."

Note that this sentence consists of two parts:

  • Part 1: x is negative or rational. This corresponds to xp is negative ⏟Npor⏟∨xp is rational ⏟R, that is, N∨R.

  • Part 2: x is positive or an integer. This corresponds to xp is positive ⏟Ppor⏟∨xp is an integer ⏟I, that is, P∨I.

So, we can express the sentence as xp is negative or rational⏟N∨Rpand⏟∧xp is positive or an integer ⏟P∨I,

that is, (N∨R)∧(P∨I).
